name: mimir
description: Chat with your local MIMIR agent directly inside VS Code

mimir.wsUrl.description: WebSocket URL the extension connects to. Leave as-is unless you start the MIMIR WS server yourself on another host or port.

mimir.pythonPath.description: Python executable used to start the WS server. Leave empty: install.sh records the venv interpreter in ~/.mimir/python and the extension picks it up (the MIMIR_PYTHON environment variable also works). Set this only to override both.

mimir.ollamaUrl.description: Default address of your running Ollama server, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:11434. Editable in the connect panel — this is only the value it starts with.

mimir.backend.description: LLM backend: vllm (default, OpenAI-compatible API), ollama, or anthropic (hosted Claude API)

mimir.anthropicAvailableModels.description: Claude model IDs shown in the model selector when backend is Anthropic. Edit in settings.json to add or reorder models.

mimir.vllmBaseUrl.description: Default address of your running vLLM server, e.g. http://10.0.0.4:8000. Editable in the connect panel — this is only the value it starts with.

mimir.vllmVerifySsl.description: Verify the vLLM endpoint's TLS certificate. Disable (uncheck) for internal HTTPS routes served behind a private/corporate CA that isn't in the system trust store (avoids CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED). Sets VLLM_VERIFY_SSL=0 for the server.

mimir.notifications.enabled.description: Show a native VS Code notification when a task completes or MIMIR needs your input, and the chat view is not focused/visible.
